## Type

- [ ] False positive — Kenaz flagged a safe plugin
- [ ] Missed detection — Kenaz passed a plugin it should have flagged

## Plugin audited

Name or link to the plugin (if public). If it's private, describe the relevant code pattern.

## Rule(s) involved

Which PA-XXX rule fired (or should have fired)?

## Why it is wrong

Explain why the verdict was incorrect. If false positive, explain what the code actually does. If missed detection, describe the malicious pattern.

## Suggested fix

Optional: how the rule could be adjusted to correct this.
